Greystone Managed Investments Cut Holding in Apple (AAPL) as Market Valuation Declined; Select Medical Holdings (SEM) Stock Rose While Smith Graham & Co Investment Advisors LP Has Cut by $1.58 Million Its Stake

Smith Graham & Co Investment Advisors Lp decreased its stake in Select Medical Holdings Corporation (SEM) by 13.82% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Smith Graham & Co Investment Advisors Lp sold 92,790 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.94% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 578,827 shares of the hospital and nursing management company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $10.22M, down from 671,617 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Smith Graham & Co Investment Advisors Lp who had been investing in Select Medical Holdings Corporation for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $2.43 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.63% or $0.3 during the last trading session, reaching $18.15. About 568,882 shares traded. Select Medical Holdings Corporation (NYSE:SEM) has risen 34.62% since April 22, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 23.07% the S&P500.
